gazette_location.description_raw_en: Extensions on both ends of the existing MA WANG ROAD (which was gazetted vide G.N. 2481/78 and G.N. 1752/83): one of the extensions commences at its junction with YUEN LONG ON LOK ROAD and runs generally in a west south-westerly direction for about 212 metres where it joins the eastern end of the existing MA WANG ROAD; the other extension starts from its junction with the western end of the existing MA WANG ROAD and runs in a south-westerly direction for about 181 metres before it turns to run in a southerly direction for about 67 metres where it terminates at its junction with CASTLE PEAK ROAD PING SHAN as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. LD/YL/R11.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路為公告第2841/78及1752/83號所公告之現有媽橫路兩端之延展部份：其中一端由與元朗安樂路交界處起，向西南偏西伸展約212米，至與現有之媽橫路東端連接為止。另一端則由與現有之媽橫路西端連接處起，向西南伸展約181米，然後轉向南伸展約67米，至與青山公路屏山段交界處止。在 LD/YL/R11 號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

history.submitter_remarks: EN cites previous G.N.2481/78; ZH cites 2841/78 (likely OCR/print error — description uses EN 2481).

remarks: Extension cites previous G.N.2481/78 and G.N.1752/83 (EN). ZH prints 2841/78 for the 1978 citation.
